name: status-gradient-needs-substrate
why: Prominence alone must never produce a match. Without this gate the engine degenerates into introducing everyone to the most famous person present, which is selection rather than service. RE-BASELINED 2026-09-03: the high-prominence member was m_huffman at tier 4, which he held only under the withdrawn 'OR a Wikipedia article exists' clause. He has no measurable follower count on any GREEN source, so his canonical tier is NULL and a fixture may not assert one. Swapped to m_perkins, whose tier 4 is measured (LinkedIn 370,639). The gradient is now real: Qureshi 3 -> Perkins 4, no shared industry, no shared topic, so no substrate and S8 stays silent.
defends_against: An implementation that adds the status-gradient point unconditionally whenever B outranks A.
